facts.statement: Tenant reported a bath/shower draining slowly over about 2 days at Flat 10, 30 Copperfield Walk, Willowbank, ZZ2 3ZZ on 17/04/2026.
No hazard keyword or emergency condition appears in the report or any later artefact (no gas, electrics, water ingress, heating loss, insecurity or loss of water supply), so the case is routine.
The agency advised self-help (drain cleaner and plunger) and stated that a tenant-caused blockage would be billed to the tenant, offering to instruct a contractor on that basis.
Tenant confirmed on 28/04/2026 that a plunger cleared the blockage: quoted fragment 'its now clear'.
No contractor was instructed and the job was recorded as completed without payment.

A separate tenant enquiry about renting an underground parking space was raised on 09/05/2026; the agency said it had contacted block management and would update the tenant, and the tenant acknowledged on 14/05/2026. No reply from block management is visible.
